title: Drugs, relaxant

markdown: Relaxants make the user lethargic and sleepy, giving them advantage on saving throws against effects based on negative emotions (like fear and anger) but disadvantage on saving throws against sleep-based effects and concentration checks. A renegade under the effects of a relaxant cannot get hype. The effects last for 1 hour.
